change.fix: Static and registered property descriptors now copy and recursively freeze supported metadata. Registration rejects unknown Inspector controls/commands, responsive definitions without their key and responsive.set command, empty select option lists, and empty dimension unit lists. Circular or non-data metadata is rejected.
